items.title: Buddy Collette interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: Yeah, I used to do Jimmy Lunceford’s stuff when they had reed choruses.

ctx.x: I guess so. That’s quite an ear exercise to sit with a record and try to write down the parts.
Yeah, I used to do Jimmy Lunceford’s stuff when they had reed choruses. It was very difficult, so I had to wear out a few records to hear it.
Was there much big band activity in Los Angeles during those years, let’s say early 50s?
